title: Parts of speech — Level 10 — Final challenge

tags.kisi-kisi: Noun, Pronoun, and Parts of Speech

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "The childs are playing in the yard."
items.reteach: Bentuk jamak child adalah children.

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "Her is my best friend."
items.reteach: Sebagai subjek kita pakai She: She is my best friend.

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "This bag is my."
items.reteach: Di akhir kalimat tanpa noun kita pakai mine: This bag is mine.

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "I bought two box of chalk."
items.reteach: Two diikuti bentuk jamak: two boxes.

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "Rina and me are classmates."
items.reteach: Sebagai subjek kita pakai I: Rina and I are classmates.

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "The dog wagged it's tail happily."
items.reteach: Its = miliknya. It's = it is. Jadi: its tail.

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "There are many sheeps on the farm."
items.reteach: Sheep bentuk jamaknya tetap sheep.

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "She is a honest girl."
items.reteach: Honest dibaca "onest" (h tidak dibaca), jadi an honest girl.

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "Ayah gave Andi and I some advice."
items.reteach: Sebagai objek kita pakai me: gave Andi and me.

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "We enjoyed ourself at the party."
items.reteach: Untuk we, bentuk reflexive-nya ourselves.

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "I need some informations about the trip."
items.reteach: Information adalah uncountable noun, tidak diberi -s.

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "Those book on the table are new."
items.reteach: Those dan are menunjukkan jamak, jadi books.

items.prompt: Fishing text: Which word in the text is an adverb?

stimulus.text: Every Sunday, Rudi and his grandfather go fishing at a quiet lake. Grandpa catches big fish easily, but Rudi is still learning. He waits patiently.

items.reteach: Patiently menerangkan cara Rudi menunggu, jadi adverb.

items.prompt: Fishing text: The word "He" in the last sentence refers to …

stimulus.text: Every Sunday, Rudi and his grandfather go fishing at a quiet lake. Grandpa catches big fish easily, but Rudi is still learning. He waits patiently.

items.reteach: Kalimat sebelumnya membahas Rudi yang masih belajar, jadi He = Rudi.

items.prompt: Fishing text: Which word in the text is an adjective?

stimulus.text: Every Sunday, Rudi and his grandfather go fishing at a quiet lake. Grandpa catches big fish easily, but Rudi is still learning. He waits patiently.

items.reteach: Quiet menerangkan noun lake, jadi adjective.

items.prompt: Mrs. Wati text: "it" in the second sentence refers to …

stimulus.text: Mrs. Wati sells fried bananas near our school. Her stall is small, but it is always crowded. Students love her snacks because they are cheap and tasty.

items.reteach: Her stall is small, but it is always crowded: it = her stall.

items.prompt: Mrs. Wati text: "they" in the last sentence refers to …

stimulus.text: Mrs. Wati sells fried bananas near our school. Her stall is small, but it is always crowded. Students love her snacks because they are cheap and tasty.

items.reteach: Yang murah dan enak adalah snacks-nya.

items.prompt: Mrs. Wati text: Which word in the text is a verb?

stimulus.text: Mrs. Wati sells fried bananas near our school. Her stall is small, but it is always crowded. Students love her snacks because they are cheap and tasty.

items.reteach: Sells adalah kegiatan menjual, jadi verb.

items.prompt: Coco text: "its" in the last sentence refers to …

stimulus.text: Our class has a new pet, a hamster named Coco. Coco sleeps during the day and plays at night. We clean its cage every Friday.

items.reteach: Its cage = kandang Coco.

items.prompt: Coco text: How many nouns are in "Coco sleeps during the day"?

stimulus.text: Our class has a new pet, a hamster named Coco. Coco sleeps during the day and plays at night. We clean its cage every Friday.

items.reteach: Nouns: Coco dan day. Sleeps adalah verb.

items.prompt: Coco text: The pronoun "We" means …

stimulus.text: Our class has a new pet, a hamster named Coco. Coco sleeps during the day and plays at night. We clean its cage every Friday.

items.reteach: We = kami, yaitu murid-murid di kelas itu.

items.prompt: Sports day text: "theirs" means …

stimulus.text: Dear students, our sports day is on Saturday. Please bring your own water bottle and a hat. The teachers will bring theirs too.

visual.text: the teachers' water bottles and hats

choices.say: the teachers' water bottles and hats

items.reteach: The teachers will bring theirs = para guru membawa milik mereka sendiri.

items.prompt: Sports day text: Which word is a possessive adjective?

stimulus.text: Dear students, our sports day is on Saturday. Please bring your own water bottle and a hat. The teachers will bring theirs too.

items.reteach: Our (milik kami) diikuti noun: our sports day.

items.prompt: Sports day text: "your own water bottle" means the bottle …

stimulus.text: Dear students, our sports day is on Saturday. Please bring your own water bottle and a hat. The teachers will bring theirs too.

items.reteach: Own = milik sendiri.

items.prompt: Tia: "Is this pencil case yours?" Nita: "Yes, it's ___."
items.reteach: It's mine = itu milikku.

items.prompt: Teacher: "Who broke the window?" Students: "Not ___, Ma'am!"
items.reteach: Jawaban singkat "Not us" memakai object pronoun.

items.prompt: Dodi: "Where are your shoes?" Sinta: "I put ___ under the bed."
items.reteach: Shoes jamak, sebagai objek: them.

items.prompt: Mother: "Did you meet Aunt Lia?" Rio: "Yes, I met ___ at the station."
items.reteach: Aunt Lia perempuan, sebagai objek: her.

items.prompt: Ali: "Whose bikes are these?" Ben: "They're ___. Raka and Rafi bought them yesterday."
items.reteach: Milik Raka dan Rafi = theirs.

items.prompt: Waiter: "Would you like ___ sugar in your tea?" Rina: "Yes, please."
items.reteach: Sugar uncountable. Untuk menawarkan kita pakai some.

items.prompt: Rani: "How ___ apples do we need?" Ibu: "Six."
items.reteach: Apples bisa dihitung, jadi How many.

items.prompt: Rani: "How ___ milk do we need?" Ibu: "One litre."
items.reteach: Milk tidak bisa dihitung, jadi How much.

items.prompt: Tomi: "Can you help ___ carry this box?" Edo: "Sure."
items.reteach: Help me = bantu aku. Me adalah object pronoun.

items.prompt: Coach: "You played very ___ today. Great match!"
items.reteach: Untuk menerangkan verb played kita pakai adverb well.

items.prompt: Shop assistant: "These shoes are on sale." Ita: "I'll take ___. How much are they?"
items.reteach: Shoes jamak, sebagai objek: them.

items.prompt: Tika: "Is Pak Hadi your neighbour?" Rara: "Yes, ___ house is next to mine."
items.reteach: Rumah milik Pak Hadi = his house.

items.prompt: Ganti [Budi and I] dengan pronoun: "[Budi and I] are going to Kenjeran Beach."

visual.text: We are going to Kenjeran Beach.

choices.say: We are going to Kenjeran Beach.

visual.text: They are going to Kenjeran Beach.

choices.say: They are going to Kenjeran Beach.

visual.text: Us are going to Kenjeran Beach.

choices.say: Us are going to Kenjeran Beach.

visual.text: Our are going to Kenjeran Beach.

choices.say: Our are going to Kenjeran Beach.

items.reteach: Budi and I = We.

items.prompt: Ganti [the cake] dengan pronoun: "Mother baked [the cake] last night."
items.reteach: The cake (satu benda) sebagai objek = it.

items.prompt: Ganti [my sisters] dengan pronoun: "I often help [my sisters] with homework."

visual.text: I often help them with homework.

choices.say: I often help them with homework.

visual.text: I often help they with homework.

choices.say: I often help they with homework.

visual.text: I often help their with homework.

choices.say: I often help their with homework.

visual.text: I often help theirs with homework.

choices.say: I often help theirs with homework.

items.reteach: My sisters sebagai objek = them.

items.prompt: Ganti [Pak Anton's] dengan possessive: "[Pak Anton's] car is white."
items.reteach: Milik Pak Anton = his.

items.prompt: Ganti [Lisa] dengan pronoun: "Everyone likes [Lisa]."
items.reteach: Lisa sebagai objek = her.

items.prompt: Ganti [The teacher and the students] dengan pronoun: "[The teacher and the students] planted trees."
items.reteach: Banyak orang sebagai subjek = They.

items.prompt: Susun menjadi kalimat yang benar: big / a / garden / has / house / my

visual.text: My house has a big garden.

choices.say: My house has a big garden.

visual.text: A big my house has garden.

choices.say: A big my house has garden.

visual.text: My house a big has garden.

choices.say: My house a big has garden.

visual.text: House my has a garden big.

choices.say: House my has a garden big.

items.reteach: Pola: subjek (My house) + verb (has) + objek (a big garden).

items.prompt: Susun menjadi kalimat yang benar: always / she / polite / is
items.reteach: Always diletakkan setelah to be: She is always polite.

items.prompt: Susun menjadi kalimat yang benar: they / their / did / homework / quickly
items.reteach: They = subjek, their homework = PR mereka.

items.prompt: Susun menjadi kalimat yang benar: beautiful / a / painted / picture / Sinta
items.reteach: Adjective diletakkan sebelum noun: a beautiful picture.

items.prompt: Susun menjadi kalimat yang benar: ours / that / is / not / car
items.reteach: Ours berdiri sendiri di akhir kalimat: That car is not ours.

items.prompt: Susun menjadi kalimat yang benar: bought / two / my / mother / new / dresses

visual.text: My mother bought two new dresses.

choices.say: My mother bought two new dresses.

visual.text: My mother bought new two dresses.

choices.say: My mother bought new two dresses.

visual.text: Two my mother bought new dresses.

choices.say: Two my mother bought new dresses.

visual.text: My mother two new bought dresses.

choices.say: My mother two new bought dresses.

items.reteach: Urutan: jumlah (two) lalu sifat (new) lalu noun (dresses).

items.prompt: Odd one out (bukan noun): river, mountain, quickly, island
items.reteach: River, mountain, island adalah noun. Quickly adalah adverb.

items.prompt: Odd one out (bukan verb): jump, write, happy, carry
items.reteach: Happy adalah adjective; yang lain verb.

items.prompt: Analogy: I is to me as they is to …
items.reteach: I (subjek) – me (objek). They (subjek) – them (objek).

items.prompt: Analogy: child is to children as mouse is to …
items.reteach: Plural tidak beraturan: mouse – mice.

items.prompt: Analogy: quick is to quickly as happy is to …
items.reteach: Y berubah menjadi i sebelum -ly: happily.

items.prompt: Word logic: I am a word that can replace a noun. "She", "it" and "we" are in my group. What am I?
items.reteach: Kata ganti noun disebut pronoun.

items.prompt: Riddle: Add "-ness" to me and I become a feeling. Take away "un-" from "unhappy" and you find me. What am I?
items.reteach: Unhappy tanpa un- adalah happy; happy + -ness = happiness.

items.prompt: Which word can be BOTH a noun and a verb?
items.reteach: I watch TV (verb). I have a new watch (noun).

items.prompt: Code: N = noun, V = verb, A = adjective. Which sentence follows the pattern A – N – V?
items.reteach: Hungry (A) cats (N) meow (V).

items.prompt: Count: How many pronouns are in "She called him, and he thanked her."?
items.reteach: She, him, he, her = empat pronoun.

items.prompt: Odd one out (bukan adjective): brave, honest, slowly, clever
items.reteach: Slowly adalah adverb; yang lain adjective.

items.prompt: Analogy: tooth is to teeth as foot is to …
items.reteach: Tooth – teeth, foot – feet.
